notes.title: Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]🎉 Hello adventurers![/p][p]After months of development, [b]Soul of the Dungeon[/b] is now live on Steam![/p][p]Jump in, explore the world, and don’t forget to share your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587662/a41ffa5dc44fb1feca09a078d3c21d76d62bfca6.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Soul of the Dungeon Demo Gameplay
notes.notes: [p]Join us for a live gameplay demo of [b]Soul of the Dungeon[/b], a top-down roguelike action game where you fight against waves of deadly ninja enemies and increasingly powerful bosses.[/p][h3]🔹 Live Features:[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Real-time combat[/b] demo with skill-based mechanics[/p][/*][*][p] Preview of the [b]weapons[/b] and [b]upgrade system[/b][/p][/*][*][p] Showcase of the [b]first 10 levels[/b] and [b]boss fights[/b][/p][/*][*][p] Developer commentary and behind-the-scenes details[/p][/*][/list][p]If you love fast-paced gameplay, strategic upgrades, and unique enemy encounters — this is a stream you won’t want to miss![/p][p]📅 Save the date and join the fight![/p][p][/p]
